# Isaiah Chapter 50 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 11 verses]*

*Third Servant Song; back to those who strike; face like flint; who fears the LORD?*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 50 (The Servant's Obedience) addresses third servant song; back to those who strike; face like flint; who fears the lord?. The key verse — "The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
